summary: Traffic in the town is increasing; the writer says car traffic is not a big problem, but lorry traffic is
Lorries are very noisy and can be heard inside houses, also at night
The streets are narrow, so other drivers cannot use the street when a lorry passes, which causes confusion and noise and is dangerous for lorry drivers
The writer suggests sending heavy traffic to wider streets like avenues and keeping only local traffic and buses in small streets, and asks readers for their comments
arguments: Lorries are very noisy, can be heard inside houses and also pass at night
The streets are narrow, so other drivers cannot pass when a truck is in the street, causing confusion and more noise
Driving a huge truck in a small street is hard and dangerous for the lorry drivers too
Heavy traffic should be redirected to wider streets like avenues, with only local traffic and buses in small streets
arguments_main: Names redirecting heavy traffic to wider streets as the most important argument (lorry traffic being the main problem is also acceptable)
Gives a reason from the text, e.g. it is the solution to the noise and the narrow streets
